verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Bitbucket feature for exporting all data (repositories, pull requests, issues, comments) in open formats. The only migration tooling [bitbucket-docs-15, -20] moves data into Bitbucket Cloud, not out of it. The one community report [bitbucket-comm-20] describes a departing user resorting to a manual workaround: saving static HTML of PR pages. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
